facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Bè Nắng is a floating seafood raft on the water in Phu Quoc, and most visitors never find it. Fresh catch cooked to order, feet dangling over the sea, $15-30 a person. 4.6 stars from 169 reviews, mostly locals. That ratio matters. Find it on Đ. Trần Phú before the crowds do. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Stepping onto a floating raft to eat grilled seafood. No resort restaurant. No tourist menu. Just locals, fresh fish, and open water. Bè Nắng hits different at $15-30 a head.
